entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane with a twin timeline, where dragons either died out or dragonlords took over the clans.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker whose path winds through both Tarkir timelines.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon who teaches the clans and fights Nicol Bolas; planeswalker.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who corrupts Yasova and battles Ugin.

entities.name: Alesha
entities.description: Becomes khan of the Mardu.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Corrupted by Nicol Bolas; later khan of the Temur.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Khan of the Jeskai whose spark ignites; planeswalker.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: Khan of the Sultai.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: Khan of the Temur.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Khan of the Mardu.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Leaves the Jeskai for the Sultai and later performs a corrupted ritual with Sarkhan.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker who arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin.

entities.name: Varuk
entities.description: Takes control of the Mardu after Zurgo.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: Surrenders to Silumgar and betrays the khans' meeting.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: Khan of the Jeskai who gives up her life to make peace with Ojutai.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan holdouts, killed by Silumgar.

entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: Allies with Dromoka and forces the Abzan to give up ancestor worship.

entities.name: Oret
entities.description: Anafenza's cousin who executes her.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who recruits Narset to investigate the dragonstorm outbreak.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: Planeswalker who steals the Spirit-Gem in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Dragonlord of the Sultai.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord of the Jeskai.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Dragonlord of the Mardu.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: Dragonlord of the Temur.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: Dragonlord of the Abzan.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: Realm where Ugin detains Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Crux of Fate
entities.description: Battle in which Ugin and Nicol Bolas fight and Ugin is gravely wounded.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the multiverse.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas corrupts Yasova Dragonclaw and battles Ugin, coercing the dragon broods to attack their progenitor.
events.quote: Bolas coerces the Dragon broods to attack their progenitor.

events.summary: In the original timeline Ugin dies and the dragon tempests cease; the dragons are hunted to extinction.
events.quote: Ugin dies. The dragon tempests cease.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol's spark ignites and he leaves Tarkir.
events.quote: Planeswalker's spark ignites and he leaves Tarkir.

events.summary: Sarkhan, Narset and Zurgo reach Ugin's Nexus and Sarkhan travels 1280 years back in time.
events.quote: Sarkhan enters the Nexus of Fate and travels 1280 years backward in time.

events.summary: Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon, increasing the dragon tempests and creating the current timeline.
events.quote: Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon. The dragon tempests increase.

events.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting at Dirgur stronghold; Reyhan is killed and Shu Yun and the Ghostfire initiates give their lives.
events.quote: Tasigur betrays the location to the dragonlords.

events.summary: Alesha and the Mardu follow the dragonlord Kolaghan.
events.quote: Alesha and the Mardu decide to forsake their previous clan and follow dragonlord Kolaghan .

events.summary: Anafenza is executed by Oret; Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.
events.quote: Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.

events.summary: Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his hedron cocoon.
events.quote: Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his Hedron cocoon.

events.summary: Elspeth and Narset find Jace in the Meditation Realm; Jace steals the Spirit-Gem, fails and seemingly dies, and Nicol Bolas escapes.
events.quote: He fails and seemingly dies, and Nicol Bolas escapes in the process.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol and Taigam perform a corrupted ritual to control the wild dragons, and Ugin returns and defeats Sarkhan.
events.quote: Ugin returns to Tarkir, defeats Sarkhan, and puts a stop to the dragonstorm outbreak.

events.summary: Sarkhan loses his planeswalker spark alongside Narset and others.
events.quote: Sarkhan loses his planeswalker spark alongside others, including Narset.
